answer: Challenge issue is rate limited to 12 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. An operator running 82 keys therefore pays for 82 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the anchor quota and the cedar admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the beacon ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
